Witty-QuickGuide-EN.pdf.page_content:
Documentation
The Witty Kit user manual is stored on the USB stick 
inside the backpack pocket. Please open or print the 
PDF file referred to in this Quick Guide.
Photocells
To switch on the photocell press the ON button for one second; the status LED blinks with a green light (if the batte-
ry status is sufficient) or with an orange light (if the battery status is low). A continuous beeping sound is produced 
until the correct alignment with the reflector (or a similar reflecting surface) is found.
Mount the photocells and the reflectors on the tripods supplied with the kit as explained in chapter 2.2.1
Charging
To recharge the timer and the photocells connect the 
plug that is compatible with your national mains type 
(Europe, UK, USA, Australia). Connect the USB cables 
to the power supply and the devices to charge.
How to Quickly Carry out your 
First Test
Please refer to chapter 3 of the user manual for  
a detailed description of the steps to follow to carry  
out a simple timing test.
Contents of the Kit
• 1 Witty timer
• 2 wireless photocells
• 2 reflectors
• 4 telescopic tripods
• 1 battery charger (for charging both photocells  
and the timer simultaneously)
• 4 USB cables
• 1 padded backpack for transport
• 1 USB memory stick containing Witty manuals and software
• 1 Quick Guide (hard copy)
Witty Timer
To switch on the Witty timer, press <Microgate> and hold it for one second; to switch it off, press the same button 
and hold it for 5 seconds, then confirm pressing F1. (chap. 2.1)
Browse the graphic user interface using the 4 arrow keys of the keypad, use the <Ok> button in the center to 
confirm, and the <Microgate> button to go back (Back/Esc) (chap. 2.4)

Witty-Financial-Report-2025.pdf.page_content:
MICROGATE S.R.L. - QUARTERLY FINANCIAL REPORT (Q3 2025) 
Department: Finance Department 
Confidentiality Level: STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL (Management Only) 
Subject: Witty Product Line Performance and Year-End Forecasts

metadata.global_topic: Witty product line Q3 2025 financial performance

Witty-Financial-Report-2025.pdf.page_content:
1. Executive Summary 
The third quarter of 2025 solidified Microgate's position as a leader in sports 
timing, based in Bolzano, Italy. Our flagship product, the Witty Wireless Training 
Timer, was once again the primary revenue driver. Adoption of our wireless 
technology by high-performance centers exceeded sales expectations by 18% 
year-over-year.

metadata.global_topic: Witty product line Q3 2025 financial performance

Witty-Financial-Report-2025.pdf.page_content:
2. Revenue Breakdown by Product 
Gross revenue for the sports division reached €4.2 million this quarter. Sales are 
distributed across the following categories: 
• Hardware Sales (Complete Kits): This represents 65% of revenue. The standard 
package has been very well received commercially because it includes everything 
the end customer needs: 1 Witty timer, 2 wireless photocells, 2 reflectors, and 4 
telescopic tripods. 
 
• Accessories and Spare Parts: This represents 15% of revenue. Individual sales of 
padded carrying backpacks and simultaneous battery chargers are particularly 
noteworthy. 
 
• Corporate Software Licenses: This represents 20% of revenue. Although the 
basic Witty Manager software is included on a USB drive with the kit, enterprise 
licenses for Windows OS (XP/Vista/7/8) have generated significant recurring 
revenue.

metadata.global_topic: Witty product line Q3 2025 financial performance

Witty-Financial-Report-2025.pdf.page_content:
3. Operating Costs and Logistics 
The cost of goods sold (COGS) has remained stable. However, we have observed a 
slight increase of 4% in packaging costs due to the inclusion of printed manuals 
(Quick Start Guide) in each box. 

 
On the other hand, technical support costs have decreased thanks to 
improvements in the stopwatch's user interface, specifically in navigation using 
the four arrow keys on the keypad and the central <OK> button for confirming 
actions. Issues related to photocell alignment have also been drastically reduced, 
as the system emits a continuous beep until correct alignment with the reflector is 
achieved.

metadata.global_topic: Witty product line Q3 2025 financial performance

Witty-Financial-Report-2025.pdf.page_content:
4. R&D Forecast and Strategy 
For next year, the R&D budget will allocate €1.5 million to improving device 
autonomy. Currently, the photocell status LED flashes orange when the battery 
level is low. The technical objective is to implement next-generation lithium 
batteries that will increase autonomy by 40%, thus reducing the frequency of 
recharging via the supplied USB cables.

metadata.global_topic: Witty product line Q3 2025 financial performance

product_photocell_alignment.md.page_content:
# Photocell Alignment & Calibration Guide
**Applicable to:** Witty Photocell v3.x and v4.x

metadata.global_topic: Photocell alignment, calibration, and multi-gate configuration

product_photocell_alignment.md.page_content:
## 1. Initial Setup
Mount the photocell on the telescopic tripod at a height between 80cm and 120cm. Position the reflector directly opposite at the same height, with a clear line of sight.

metadata.global_topic: Photocell alignment, calibration, and multi-gate configuration

product_photocell_alignment.md.page_content:
## 2. Alignment Procedure
1. Power on the photocell by pressing the ON button for 1 second
2. The status LED will blink green (battery OK) or orange (battery low)
3. Rotate the photocell slowly until the continuous beep stops — this indicates correct alignment
4. Lock the tripod head to fix the position

metadata.global_topic: Photocell alignment, calibration, and multi-gate configuration

product_photocell_alignment.md.page_content:
## 3. Calibration Verification
Run a test pass through the photocell beam. The timer should register a split time. If no time is recorded:
- Check reflector angle (must be perpendicular to beam)
- Clean the photocell lens with the included microfiber cloth
- Verify that the timer and photocell are on the same channel (Settings > Wireless > Channel)

metadata.global_topic: Photocell alignment, calibration, and multi-gate configuration

product_photocell_alignment.md.page_content:
## 4. Multi-Gate Configuration
For training courses with multiple gates (e.g., agility drills):
- Maximum 8 photocell pairs per timer
- Assign sequential gate numbers (Gate 1, Gate 2, etc.)
- Minimum distance between gates: 2 meters
- The timer automatically computes split times and total elapsed time

metadata.global_topic: Photocell alignment, calibration, and multi-gate configuration

product_photocell_alignment.md.page_content:
## 5. Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Cause | Solution |
|---------|-------|----------|
| No beep during alignment | Reflector misaligned | Adjust angle by ±5° |
| Intermittent timing | Obstruction in beam path | Clear debris/moisture |
| Short battery life | Firmware outdated | Update via Witty Manager |

metadata.global_topic: Photocell alignment, calibration, and multi-gate configuration
